General introduction
The program is application-oriented, specializing in integrated circuit (IC) design, including digital integrated circuits, analog integrated circuits, mixed-signal integrated circuits, integrated systems on chip, and packaging and testing. Students are equipped with a solid foundation of knowledge, combined with in-depth practical training on advanced, industry-standard integrated circuit design tools.
This is one of the few training programs in Vietnam that awards a Bachelor of Integrated Circuit Design degree, closely aligned with the nation's semiconductor industry development strategy.
Students will comprehensively develop professional skills, problem-solving skills, systems thinking, and creativity, preparing them to participate in the field of integrated circuit and semiconductor design – a strategic industry receiving significant investment in Vietnam and globally.
The Integrated Circuit Design field comprises three specializations:
Analog and digital integrated circuit design
Semiconductor integrated circuit components
Integrated systems-on-chip (IC) design & applications
Digital integrated circuit design, Analog integrated circuit design, Mixed-signal integrated circuit design
Design verification and validation
Semiconductor component modeling and simulation
Semiconductor manufacturing and fabrication technology
Technology and design for packaging and testing of integrated circuits.
System-on-a-chip (SoC) design
Specialized integrated circuit systems for AI, IoT, biomedical, and cryptography.
Computer system and microprocessor design

Output standard
1. Knowledge
The ability to identify, formulate, and solve complex technical problems in the field of integrated circuit design by applying mathematical and engineering principles combined with digital capabilities and artificial intelligence.
The ability to apply engineering design to develop solutions that meet specific needs in the electronics field, integrated circuit design oriented towards innovation and entrepreneurship, while considering health, safety, public welfare, human rights, as well as global, cultural, social, environmental and economic factors.
2. Skills
The ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of audiences and stakeholders, including technical experts, leaders, and non-specialist groups, ensures clarity and accuracy in the presentation and transmission of information.
The ability to work effectively in a professional team, where members lead together, to create a collaborative and supportive environment, set goals, plan tasks, and achieve common objectives.

3. Mức tự chủ và trách nhiệm
Khả năng nhận biết trách nhiệm đạo đức và nghề nghiệp trong các tình huống kỹ thuật, và đưa ra các phán đoán sáng suốt có tính đến tác động của giải pháp kỹ thuật trong bối cảnh toàn cầu, có cân nhắc đến phát triển bền vững đối với kinh tế, môi trường và xã hội.
Khả năng tiếp thu và áp dụng kiến thức mới để đáp ứng sự phát triển nhanh chóng của công nghệ, thông qua việc vận dụng các chiến lược học tập phù hợp để bảo đảm khả năng học tập suốt đời.
